♌ The Leo Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Lightning Bolt]

Cloth Passive — Pride of the Lion

You are immune to the frightened condition and to fear effects. You are trained in Intimidation and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Demoralize.

Ascendant Boon — Lightning Plasma [OFFENSE]

Your fists gain the agile trait and deal an additional 1d6 electricity damage.

You gain an extra action at the start of each of your turns, which you can use only to Strike or Stride.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Leo)]

Zenith Boon — Lightning Plasma (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, but your fists deal an additional 3d6 electricity damage, and you are quickened 1 (Strike or Stride only) in addition to the extra action — two extra actions each turn.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Leo)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Lightning Plasma

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Lightning Plasma]
